text:
alex_newport: Hi team — we'd like to onboard a private model for returns classification + conversational assistant for our support flow. It's a fine-tuned llama2-7b variant we host as a gguf artifact. Requirements: token-level audit logs, redaction of PANs/PII, throughput ~120 req/s. Who owns safety/evals and deployment options?

maria_cs: Thanks Alex — looping in @ashok_se (solutions eng) and @devon_am (account). Quick q: is the model already fine-tuned and stable or do you want help managing training/finetune?

alex_newport: Already fine-tuned, we have model files and a container. Preference is Redwood Private (VPC) for PCI compliance but open to Dedicated if easier. Also need explicit redaction rules and audit trail for compliance.

ashok_se: We can support VPC Private. Two asks to start: (1) a safety spec — list of sensitive entity types to redact and any forbidden behaviors, (2) an eval dataset / prompt set and baseline metrics (accuracy, FPR on fraud cases, hallucination rate). Try to share ~50–200 examples.

alex_newport: We'll share 150 annotated examples + a couple full user flows. Also need latency SLOs — target 99th < 250ms, p95 ~100ms. Is that feasible?

devon_am: That 99th is aggressive but might be achievable with the right provisioning (e.g., 8xA10G or similar). We'll run perf tests. Also want to flag contract/renewal: this is a 3-month pilot with potential scale — we need clarity on data retention, SLA, and rollback policy.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Next steps: Alex to upload sample set to secure intake, engineering will run evals, we produce safety checklist + quant/recommendation report. I'll schedule an enablement sync.

alex_newport: Uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-onboard/newport/returns_sample_v1.zip — access granted to redwood-onboard@redwood.com. Also we need an NDA/CA signed before full evals.

onboard-bot: Ticket #CS-4826 created for Newport model onboarding. Assignee: ashok_se. Due: 2026-04-03.

ashok_se: Acknowledged. I'll start a compatibility pass: model format (gguf?), tokenizer, kv-cache behavior. Alex — what exact quantization and tokenizer are you using? Any custom ops?

alex_newport: Model: llama2-7b finetuned, gguf, int8 quant. Tokenizer: huggingface/llama-tokenizer. No custom kernels.

ashok_se: int8 is supported in our runtime path. We'll run a perf + safety pass. Couple things to confirm: do you prefer model-side redaction (during generation) or post-process redaction?

alex_newport: Prefer model-side to reduce surface for leaking, but need post-process audit record (redacted tokens + reason) for compliance.

devon_am: We'll implement a hybrid: model-side detection with a lightweight post-processing redactor and token-level logging. Also will include fallback routing to a smaller model when capacity spikes. Maria — can you send the contract rider template for retention & del retention windows?

maria_cs: Sending template now. Also flagging potential renewal risk: if pilot misses latency/accuracy targets we will need to renegotiate commitments. Devon — please include cost delta for Dedicated vs Private and break-even at projected QPS.

devon_am: Will produce an ops & cost estimate and break-even analysis. Also we'll propose an A/B rollout: start with 10% traffic -> 50% after perf pass -> full.

alex_newport: Thanks — can we aim for initial eval results by EOD Friday?

ashok_se: We'll aim for Friday EOD. I'll post perf numbers + a short eval summary CSV back here.

maria_cs: :calendar: Sync scheduled Thu 10:00 AM PT for onboarding kickoff.

alex_newport: Appreciate it. If you need access changes to the bucket ping me.

end of thread
